title: FrameMarkRender v1
description: Engine <-> UI render contract v1 (task book 3.3). A document is either a render request or a render response; the two shapes are disjoint, so the root oneOf doubles as a kind check. Big images always travel as paths, never as bytes: photo.path points at the file on disk and response.image.path at the engine output. The only byte payload allowed is response.image.rgba, reserved for tiny previews (returned image max edge <= 512 px); it is base64 of raw RGBA8888 rows, length exactly w*h*4 bytes.

pathString.description: Absolute file path (or file URI on Android). Never inline image data.

design.description: Design JSON (D9). Opaque to the render contract: its inner structure is owned by the Design layer; the engine only requires it to be a non-empty object carrying styleId.

maxEdge.description: Preview only: longest edge of the returned image, in pixels.

band.description: Export only: vertical strip to render, in output pixel space.

overlay.description: Optional user watermark (transparent PNG/WebP), composited above the photo and below the template's border/text/logo. Absent = no overlay layer, and the output is unchanged.

photoRef.description: The source photo is referenced by path + intrinsic pixel size. Byte payloads (bytes/data/base64 fields) are forbidden by design and rejected by additionalProperties.

overlay.description: User watermark layer. Semantics (v1, additive): z-order = immediately above the photo layer, below every border/text/logo the template paints afterwards; clipped to the photo draw box; contain + centre inside `rect` (never stretched, aspect preserved); `opacity` multiplies the image alpha. A missing or undecodable path is a hard error, never a silent no-op.

opacity.description: Global alpha multiplier applied to the overlay image's alpha channel.

unitRect.description: Rectangle normalised to the photo draw box (origin at that box's top-left, 0..1 on both axes). The overlay is contained inside it; parts outside the photo box are clipped.

engine.description: Optional provenance marker (v1 additive field). 'fake' = FakeEngine/golden-image path, 'native' = real engine. UI must not present 'fake' output as live parameter rendering.

imageRgba.description: Tiny previews only (max(w,h) <= 512). Base64 of raw RGBA8888 rows, decoded length must be w*h*4.

rect.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in response image pixel space (origin top-left). When the request carried a band, coordinates are relative to the returned strip (add band.y to get canvas space). x/y may be negative when the photo bleeds outside the canvas.

textSlot.description: Measured fill region for one text slot, in response image pixel space (band-local when the request carried a band). The engine does not return glyph runs in v1; the UI only needs the box for overlay/hit-testing.
